Diabetic Brownies
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




teaspoon Baking Powder
teaspoon Salt
3 ounces Unsweetened Chocolate, melted
cup Shortening, soft
2 Eggs, beaten
2 tablespoons Granulated Sugar Replacement
cup Flour
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients and beat vigorously until well blended. Spread mixture into greased 8 inch square pan. Bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes. 2 Cut into 2 inch squares. 3 Microwave: Cook on Medium for 8 to 10 minutes, or until puffed and dry on top. Cut into 2 inch squares.
